decision.title: The QT4 driver for Phase 2: environments, scope, areas (packet )

item.p: Environments now applied: decimal-format (every attribute one property, value as written; the name's prefix bound by the element's in-scope namespaces, unprefixed names in no namespace); (any URI runs: codepoint, HTML ASCII, UCA unless fallback=no; default="true" sets default_collation_uri; other URIs stay "environment collation"; the driver's own check until 2.12's sxml_collation_is_supported exists); and through a resource table (resource_table.c, glossary ): TEXT and BINARY by the resource's absolute URI (relative ones against the test-set file; TEXT gets the encoding attribute as the external encoding), else file:///SUITE-PATH; COLLECTION and URI_COLLECTION as SEQUENCE (document nodes, or their document URIs as xs:anyURI), uri="" is the default collection; collection sources with a uri are also available documents; a collection's resources are served like the environment's and their URIs follow the documents' in fn:uri-collection. Still skipped: collections with a query (3.13). Resources are not served to fn:doc.

Dependencies now satisfied: feature simple-uca-fallback, non_empty_sequence_collection, arbitraryPrecisionDecimal; unicode-normalization-form NFC NFD NFKC NFKD (Phase 2 makes them work; the denominator counts their cases anyway). Not collection-stability: its two cases ask for it to be absent.

Scope: applicability also says whether a case is in the denominator (spec matches, no non-goal test set, no required non-goal feature; tables in applicability.c). Out-of-scope cases that apply still run, so pass counts stay comparable. sxml-qt4 list ends with "N test cases: A applicable, S skipped; D in scope" and marks "out of scope: ..."; list --spec=XP40 gives 31,543 in scope, --spec=XQ40 41,174 (: about 31,500 and 41,200).

JSON report (still version 1, members only added): test sets, totals and a new areas array ('s prefixes) carry in_scope and in_scope_passed; in_scope_passed / in_scope is the gate rate. tools/conformance-report.py (1.27) may read them; it ignores them now.
Measured (release): XP40 passed 23,146 to 24,451, no pass lost; not run 18,448 to 16,321. The ten new "error" outcomes are UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE in newly run cases, not the driver.
